item.title: Autonomous Vehicle Perception
item.description:
Overview

A computer-vision project developed as part of my Master’s studies.

The project explores perception for autonomous-vehicle scenarios, including situations such as driver distraction and passenger posture.

Technology Stack

  • Python
  • Computer Vision
  • Machine Learning
